keywords: ethrex 隐私路线图测试网
EIP-8037 跨帧状态 gas 修复
summary: ethrex 开放一个基于 Glamsterdam 的公开测试网，同时运行 EIP-8141、EIP-8250、EIP-8272、FOCIL 和 VOPS，这些都是隐私路线图背后的 EIP。EIP-8037 合并两处跨帧修复：回滚时按帧起点恢复状态 gas，子帧合并时把状态 gas 还给 `gas_left`。EIP-8130 改名为 Keystore Accounts。Flashbots 表态支持 Hegotá 的 quick slots。

items.title: EIP-8037：回滚时恢复帧的状态 gas
items.note: 合并（chfast）。原规则说回滚时退还“帧内收取的”状态 gas，但没有计数器记录这个量；PR 引入帧起点储备，使两个计数器相同的帧回滚时不会欠不同的数额。
items.title_en: EIP-8037: restore a frame's state gas on rollback
items.note_en: Was merged (chfast). The rule said rollbacks refill the state gas "charged within the frame", but no counter held that quantity; the PR introduces the frame's starting reservoir so two frames with equal counters cannot revert owing different amounts.
items.topic_en: Getting frame transactions and EIP-8037 ready

items.topic: frame 交易和 EIP-8037 的落地准备
items.title: EIP-8037：子帧合并时把状态 gas 还给 gas_left
items.note: 合并（chfast）。原理由承诺执行 gas 不会永久困在储备里，但规则做不到：两个兄弟调用（ERC-4337 bundle 的形状）就能让第一笔写新槽从 `gas_left` 溢出 97,920，第二笔清空时退款却进了储备。
items.title_en: EIP-8037: return state gas to gas_left when a child merges
items.note_en: Was merged (chfast). The rationale promised execution gas would never be stranded in the reservoir, but the rules did not deliver: two sibling calls, the shape of an ERC-4337 bundle, are enough for the first call's write to a fresh slot to spill 97,920 from `gas_left` while the second call's clearing refund lands in the reservoir.

items.title: 新 ERC：声明式钱包签名策略
items.note: （moodysalem，ERC-8411），提前声明钱包可以不经人工签哪些交易：对每个计划调用、交易信封和请求通道做有序的 `allow`、`review`、`deny` 规则。
items.title_en: New ERC: declarative wallet signing policy
items.note_en: (moodysalem, ERC-8411), stating in advance which transactions a wallet may sign without asking a human through an ordered list of `allow`, `review` and `deny` rules over each planned call, the transaction envelope and the request channel.

items.note_en: (ERC-8412), for AI agents, scheduled jobs and other clients that cannot approve on their own to submit and track transactions; the same batch included ERC-8410 portable execution plan artifact.

summary_en: ethrex opened a public testnet built on Glamsterdam that runs EIP-8141, EIP-8250, EIP-8272, FOCIL and VOPS together, the EIPs behind the privacy roadmap. EIP-8037 merged two cross-frame fixes: rollbacks restore state gas relative to the frame's starting point, and merging child frames returns state gas to `gas_left`. EIP-8130 was renamed Keystore Accounts. Flashbots came out in support of quick slots for Hegotá.
